prompt.generated_prompt_string: Cinematic luxury fashion editorial on a grand historic staircase. An original adult woman with long straight platinum-blonde hair stands poised on polished stone steps, wearing a pale-aqua sequin sleeveless knee-length dress, ivory pointed-toe heels, minimal silver jewelry, and a small crystal-beaded handbag. One foot rests on a lower step, one hand comes gently near her face, and she meets camera with a calm confident gaze. Shoot a vertical full-length portrait from a refined low angle that preserves natural proportions. Include ornate stair railings, converging brick walls, softly blurred upper landings, and warm ambient architectural light. Use realistic skin texture, controlled sequin reflections, natural anatomy, gentle film grain, and moody high-end editorial color.
